CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.account_session_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null
    and coalesce((auth.jwt() ->> 'is_anonymous')::boolean, false) = false
    and exists (
      select 1 from auth.sessions
      where user_id = auth.uid()
        and id::text = auth.jwt() ->> 'session_id'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_session_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select private.account_session_active(); $function$
